value.rationale: The smallest interior dihedral angle is a standard finite-element mesh quality measure. This solves its sharp optimization for the full natural two-parameter path-tetrahedron similarity family, with unique optimizer, exact feasible domain for every quality threshold, and a genuine 45-degree compactness transition in shape space. The result is not a numerical local optimum, a single example, or a restatement of the known angle-sum bound. It does not claim broader mesh convergence consequences.
